ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Rest with the foot up; it passes in three to six days, a little sooner with tending. Plainer meals with fruit or vegetables and fewer drinks make it come back half as often. Only colonists of 45 or over get it.

They pass in a few days. Stone-dust cough comes from four hours or more of mining under the mountain, or of cutting stone blocks in a closed room of 60 cells or fewer: a bigger or open stone workshop and turns at the rock face prevent it. Sore knees come from five hours or more of cleaning or sowing in a day: a second cleaner prevents them.
Have a doctor tend it: a dose clears worms in a day, a salve shortens ringworm. Cooked meat and fish never bring worms; clean bedrooms and washing stop ringworm going round.
They pass on their own: bee stings in a day, a smoker's cough in a day or two without smoke. Fewer smokes keep the cough away; a beekeeper with Animals skill is stung far less.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.act: Passes in a day or two

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Fix the cause: move the butcher's table or spot out of rooms where people sleep or eat, and put an anteroom (a second door) between a bedroom and the cold outside.
